mechanism: The present PersistentWorkerPool lends a dispatch context to every awakened worker and therefore must wait for every configured worker, including workers which claim no task. The new default-off path claims a task and its current context together under the existing pool mutex; only actual task borrowers may access the context. The caller waits for every real task to return and reacquires that same mutex before retiring context. A late idle worker may only claim a task from the currently published dispatch. No task, phase, physical step or required material evolution is removed.
source_supported_motivation: The quiet existing-clock 2048 diagnostic joined all144 real physical steps and retained exact original actor trajectory and admitted movement. Mean native elapsed was97.4197ms, including46.2411ms column,16.7811ms flux,6.3276ms apply and27.3331ms outside the Wave stage brackets. These elapsed brackets include execution and descheduling. Multiple whole-pool rendezvous occur per native turn. The diagnosis does not establish that idle-worker acknowledgements dominate; this experiment tests that narrower mechanism.

The current all-worker completion implementation remains the source-matched control. No old negative experiment is reselected.

Native source changes require a new exact-source binary. The retained4bde runtime is only a reference, never reused as the treatment.
correctness_prerequisites: Exercise the actual production pool class with deliberately held idle workers and held final tasks. Count tasks exactly once, verify no return before final task writes, retire old context immediately after return, and release late workers through many reused dispatch generations.
Preserve truthful actual-task participant masks and no-op behavior for zero tasks; safe stop/join and repeated construction/retirement.
Normal and scoped ASan/UBSan pool lifecycle tests; TSan where the execution host supports it, otherwise preserve the exact infrastructure failure.

comparison.selection: Both candidate trials must improve actual physical steps per elapsed second over both controls, without worse maximum/p99 gaps or material/selected-pose age than the worse matched control. All correctness, actual actor visibility, memory/resource and ownership gates remain mandatory. A treatment with inconsistent primary improvement is NOT_ESTABLISHED, even if one native stage or CPU metric improves.
comparison.later_gates: Any promising result needs medium/mixed/reference workloads, resulting-source Linux/Windows qualification, larger accepted-main and frozen-donor comparisons as applicable, and sustained ordinary authoring before owner-facing selection. Physical Windows11/NVIDIA acceptance remains a separate HOLD.
